test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is correct about the ozone?

options.text: Decrease in the amount of ozone in the atmosphere is due to chlorofluorocarbons (CFC).
It is formed by combining only two atoms of oxygen.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Decrease in the amount of ozone in the atmosphere is due to chlorofluorocarbons (CFC).**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ozone** is a molecule composed of three oxygen atoms (O₃).
 
• **Ozone depletion** refers to the thinning of the ozone layer in the Earth's stratosphere.
 
• **Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs)** are the primary cause of ozone layer depletion. CFCs are man-made chemical compounds used in air conditioning, refrigeration, and aerosol propellants.
 
• When **CFCs** are released into the atmosphere, they eventually rise to the stratosphere, where they are broken down by UV radiation, releasing chlorine atoms.
 
• The chlorine atoms react with ozone molecules, causing the ozone to break down into oxygen molecules, thus depleting the ozone layer.
 
• The **Montreal Protocol** was established in 1987 to phase out the production and use of substances that deplete the ozone layer, including CFCs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **It is not poisonous.**__

 __
 
• **Ozone** at ground level is harmful and can cause respiratory problems and other health issues. While in the stratosphere, it is essential for blocking harmful UV radiation.
 
 
 
• **It is formed by combining only two atoms of oxygen.**__
 __
 
• Ozone is actually formed by combining three oxygen atoms (O₃), not two. The molecule of two oxygen atoms is regular oxygen (O₂).
 
 
 
• **It causes blood cancer.**__
 
 
• There is no direct evidence linking ozone to blood cancer. However, exposure to high levels of ground-level ozone can cause respiratory problems and other health issues.
